Support NovaClient.

Premium adds cosmetic customization to your licensed client. Your role controls which options are available.

Supporter & Owner

Solid badge colors, gradients and RGB, plus the Premium appearance and animation settings. Owner keeps the crown indicator.

Collaborator

Solid badge colors and gradients. RGB and other Premium adjustments require Supporter or Owner.

Member

The Premium tab is disabled. You can still use the features included with your active license.

Verify your license.

Sign in with Discord and verify the activated NovaClient license linked to your account before viewing payment details. Account sign-in alone does not grant a role, achievement or custom title.
